newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Ciller says government change in few days.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Ciller says government change in few days.

text.p: Turkey's Deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller said on Wednesday there would be a change of government within days to solve a row which has brought the Islamist-led coalition to the breaking point.
"A change of government is expected in the coming days," Ciller told deputies from her True Path Party (DYP) in parliament.

Ciller and Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan announced on June 1 that they would seek early elections to overcome a growing dispute with the secular establishment over demands for a crackdown on religious activism.
The two partners did not propose a date for elections, which would have to be approved by parliament.
"This government is unable to act, that is true. This government is no longer a government of action. But someone must bring to the people the trust with which they were endowed," Ciller said.
The strength of the coalition formed in June last year has been eroded by the defection of a number of DYP deputies, which has left the government with a razor-thin majority in parliament.
